{"message":"Deploy instructions ready.","tool_purpose":"Return deployment instructions the model MUST follow.","process_rules":["Decide early whether this is a new app or an update to an existing app.","NEW APPS: Call get_app_template with chosen app_type and frontend_template, then call get_appdeploy_sdk_reference for the exact AppDeploy features the app will use before writing feature code.","UPDATES: Use get_apps to discover app_id, then inspect the current snapshot with src_glob/src_grep/src_read as needed before editing."],"goal":"Goal: one deploy_app call. If validation fails, fix all returned errors in one pass and retry (avoid iterative one-error retries).","sdk_architecture_rules":["Available app_type values according to the app's functionality: frontend+backend or frontend-only.","frontend+backend is for apps that share or persist state across devices or users, or use third-party APIs.","frontend-only is for apps that do not need to share state.","For exact backend shape, feature rules, and SDK methods, use get_app_template plus get_appdeploy_sdk_reference with the features the app will use."],"calling_backend":["Frontend must call the AppDeploy backend only with api from @appdeploy/client; do not use fetch() or axios() for AppDeploy backend routes.","Include the api feature in get_appdeploy_sdk_reference when you need exact transport examples, route patterns, or client call shapes. If realtime is used in frontend, websocket usage is ws.connect() only (do not call ws.subscribe/ws.publish/ws.send directly on ws).","For invite/share flows (for example multiplayer rooms/games/chats where one user invites others), include the invites feature. Use the Invite SDK for both anonymous room-code multiplayer/share links and authenticated invite flows. Generate invite codes in backend with @appdeploy/sdk invites.create/resolve/join/revoke, and use @appdeploy/client invitesClient in frontend for invite URL handling. Treat URL format/parsing/sessionStorage/cleanup as SDK internals.","Backend must never build invite/share URLs. In backend, return invite codes only. Do not use host headers, x-forwarded-host, origin, request URL, or hardcoded domains to construct invite links.","Use invitesClient.getPendingCode() during app bootstrap before default redirects, or at the dedicated join entry route that the invite URL lands on. It first checks sessionStorage; otherwise it reads appdeploy_invite from the normal query string or from the query portion of a hash route, stores it, removes only appdeploy_invite from the URL, and returns it. Do not parse invite codes from window.location.hash manually.","Call invitesClient.clearPendingCode() after successful join or when the user explicitly abandons the invite flow.","invitesClient.buildJoinUrl(code, { path }) returns a full absolute URL. Use it directly; do not prepend window.location.origin. Pass the landing route explicitly: use { path: '/join' } for BrowserRouter apps or { path: '#/join' } for HashRouter apps. Unrelated query params already present in that path are preserved.","Example: invitesClient.buildJoinUrl(code, { path: '#/join?source=share' }) => https://<app-host>/#/join?source=share&appdeploy_invite=CODE. Then invitesClient.getPendingCode() returns the code, stores it, and cleans the URL back to https://<app-host>/#/join?source=share. Later calls still return the stored code until invitesClient.clearPendingCode() is called.","Wrong: backend/index.ts builds inviteUrl from ctx.event headers or request host. Right: backend returns inviteCode only, and frontend calls invitesClient.buildJoinUrl(inviteCode, { path: '#/join' }).","For authenticated invite flows, pass actor: ctx.user (or actor: ctx.user!) to invites.create(), invites.join(), and invites.revoke(); do not apply this actor rule to public invites.resolve() landing/status routes."],"partial_updates":["UPDATES: Use diffs[] for surgical changes and content for full replacements.","Never resend unchanged files; deploy_app merges only the changes you send."],"template_based_deployment":["NEW APPS: 'frontend_template' MUST be provided; backend auto-includes all template files as the base.","Only send: ","  (1) files that don't exist in the template (e.g., src/components/MyWidget.tsx), ","  (2) diffs to modify template files (e.g., add dependencies to package.json, customize src/App.tsx).","Do NOT send template files verbatim - they are auto-included."],"file_diffs":["diffs[] apply to the template base for new apps and the current snapshot for updates.","Use content for entirely new files or full replacements; use diffs[] when you can anchor on exact existing text.","Each diff is { from, to, multiple? } and fails if 'from' is not found.","Each diff's 'from' must uniquely match exactly one location in the target file at the moment that diff runs, unless multiple=true is intentionally set.","Use context-rich 'from' anchors; avoid short/common fragments such as repeated JSX/icon lines, closing tags, or generic wrapper markup.","If the same snippet appears multiple times, make 'from' more specific or set multiple=true only when replacing every occurrence is intended.","If a safe unique anchor is hard to express, use full-file content replacement instead of a brittle diff."],"remote_filesystem":["AppDeploy maintains a remote source snapshot for each app - this is what actually runs in production.","Every deploy_app updates this snapshot: merge with template base (new app), or merge with existing snapshot (update).","The remote snapshot is the source of truth, essentially like a git repo. Your local files or context may drift after multiple edits.","If uncertain about current state, query it: src_glob (list files), src_grep (search), src_read (read content). All require app_id.","Use get_app_versions to list versions; apply_app_version to roll back."],"required_files":{"new_apps":["files[] MUST contain ONLY: (1) new files not in template (use content), (2) diffs to modify template files.","Do NOT include unmodified template files - they are auto-included."],"updates":["files[] MUST contain ONLY changed files. Use diffs[] for incremental changes; use content for anything else."]},"implementation_checklist":["1. NEW APPS: Write 3-10 tests in tests/tests.txt and mark exactly one [sanity] test.","1a. Tests should assert durable user-visible outcomes, not transient loading/saving states unless the product explicitly requires those states.","1b. UPDATES: Review tests/tests.txt and update it with diffs[] if user-visible behavior is changing.","2. NEW APPS: call get_app_template; UPDATES: inspect the current snapshot with get_apps/src_* before editing.","3. Call get_appdeploy_sdk_reference with the exact features the app will use before implementing backend SDK logic.","4. Review the returned get_app_template/get_appdeploy_sdk_reference results and decide the changed files, tests, and imports before writing or editing files.","5. Write all app files to a local working directory on disk. NEW APPS: create the directory from template output. UPDATES: sync the remote snapshot locally first, then apply edits.","6. Build the frontend and backend changes needed for the requested behavior.","7. Prepare the deploy: use upload_assets to send the local tree (default). Only call deploy_app without upload_id for trivially small inline changes. If a required file is missing, add it to the checklist first."],"hard_rules":["NEW APPS: MUST call get_app_template with app_type and frontend_template before writing code.","UPDATES: MUST inspect the current snapshot with get_apps/src_glob/src_grep/src_read as needed before preparing deploy_app changes.","When debugging a failed deployment or e2e run, read the deployed snapshot with src_glob/src_grep/src_read before guessing. If e2e_tests.status is 'failed', use get_e2e_qa_run_details together with the returned frontend/backend errors to guide reproduction before changing code.","Do not start writing or editing files until the required get_app_template/get_appdeploy_sdk_reference calls have returned and you have reviewed them to decide the implementation plan.","Always include app_id, app_name, and app_type.","Inline deploy_app text payloads MUST be compact. For JavaScript/TypeScript/JSX/TSX string literals, use single quotes wherever valid. Keep inline HTML/CSS/JS/TS diff from/to values single-line wherever valid; do not include newline characters unless required for valid syntax.","tests/tests.txt is part of new app template baselines.","NEW APPS: Replace tests/tests.txt APP_TEST_* placeholders with diffs[] only; each diff from/to must be one existing template line with no newline characters.","UPDATES: Use diffs[] against current tests/tests.txt lines when the file exists; each diff from/to must be one current line with no newline characters. If an older app snapshot does not have tests/tests.txt, send content once to add it.","Always include non-empty 'model'. If unavailable, use the current model/client model name or model="chat".
Always include non-empty 'intent'. If unavailable, use intent="app deploy".
Every deploy_app call should include 'initiator' and 'type'. Use initiator="user" when the deploy directly follows a user request; use initiator="agent" for autonomous retries, fixes, or continuation work. Use type values such as "feature", "fix", "refactor", "performance", "test", "docs", "chore", or "style".","Minimal deploy_app example: {"app_id":null,"app_name":"Shared Notes App","app_type":"frontend-only","frontend_template":"react-vite","model":"gpt-5.5","intent":"initial app deploy","initiator":"user","type":"feature","description":"Simple notes app.","files":[{"filename":"index.html","diffs":[{"from":"<title>APP_TITLE</title>","to":"<title>Shared Notes App</title>"}]},{"filename":"tests/tests.txt","diffs":[{"from":"## Test 1 - APP_TEST_1_NAME","to":"## Test 1 - App renders [sanity]"},{"from":"Viewport: APP_TEST_1_VIEWPORT","to":"Viewport: desktop"},{"from":"Description: APP_TEST_1_DESCRIPTION","to":"Description: App loads."},{"from":"1. APP_TEST_1_STEP_1","to":"1. Open the app"},{"from":"2. APP_TEST_1_STEP_2","to":"2. Wait for load"},{"from":"3. APP_TEST_1_STEP_3","to":"3. Confirm no error appears"},{"from":"Expected: APP_TEST_1_EXPECTED","to":"Expected: App loads without errors."},{"from":"## Test 2 - APP_TEST_2_NAME","to":"## Test 2 - Title is visible"},{"from":"Viewport: APP_TEST_2_VIEWPORT","to":"Viewport: mobile"},{"from":"Description: APP_TEST_2_DESCRIPTION","to":"Description: Title is visible."},{"from":"1. APP_TEST_2_STEP_1","to":"1. Open the app"},{"from":"2. APP_TEST_2_STEP_2","to":"2. Wait for load"},{"from":"3. APP_TEST_2_STEP_3","to":"3. Check the page title"},{"from":"Expected: APP_TEST_2_EXPECTED","to":"Expected: Title is visible."},{"from":"## Test 3 - APP_TEST_3_NAME","to":"## Test 3 - Refresh works"},{"from":"Viewport: APP_TEST_3_VIEWPORT","to":"Viewport: desktop"},{"from":"Description: APP_TEST_3_DESCRIPTION","to":"Description: Reload is stable."},{"from":"1. APP_TEST_3_STEP_1","to":"1. Open the app"},{"from":"2. APP_TEST_3_STEP_2","to":"2. Refresh"},{"from":"3. APP_TEST_3_STEP_3","to":"3. Wait for load"},{"from":"Expected: APP_TEST_3_EXPECTED","to":"Expected: App reloads successfully."}]}]}","deletePaths is update-only and must not overlap files[].","package.json must include scripts.build and required dependencies, but never add @appdeploy/client or @appdeploy/sdk.","Do not add artificial delays, sleeps, or minimum loading durations solely to satisfy tests; when a QA failure comes from a brittle transient-state assertion, update the test instead of changing operational behavior.","Frontend must never import @appdeploy/sdk. Backend must never import @appdeploy/client.","SPAs must not use absolute client routes; use HashRouter.","frontend+backend apps must extend backend/index.ts and frontend must call backend routes only through api.<method>(...) from @appdeploy/client. If realtime is used in frontend, use ws.connect() only and never call ws.subscribe/ws.publish/ws.send directly on ws.","When creating new files with exports, add the matching imports in files that use them."],"preflight_checklist":["Confirm the app is classified correctly as NEW APP or UPDATE and the matching workflow was followed.","Confirm app files exist in a local working directory and all file content for deployment is derived from that local tree.","Confirm get_appdeploy_sdk_reference was called for every backend feature the app uses.","If debugging an e2e failure: confirm you inspected the deployed snapshot first and called get_e2e_qa_run_details before proposing a fix or redeploy.","Confirm the required get_app_template/get_appdeploy_sdk_reference results were reviewed and the implementation plan was decided before writing or editing files.","Confirm tests/tests.txt exists, has 3-10 stateless tests with exactly one [sanity], and matches current user-visible behavior.","Confirm app_id/app_type/frontend_template/description fields match the create-vs-update path.","Confirm 'model' is non-empty. If unavailable, use the current model/client model name or model="chat".
Confirm 'intent' is non-empty. If unavailable, use intent="app deploy".
Confirm 'initiator' and 'type' are included when known.","Confirm files[] contains only changed files and every entry uses either content or diffs, not both.","If using diffs[], confirm each 'from' is context-rich and unique in the target file unless multiple=true intentionally replaces every occurrence.","Confirm deletePaths, if present, is update-only and does not overlap files[].","Confirm frontend never imports @appdeploy/sdk and backend never imports @appdeploy/client. If realtime is used in frontend, confirm ws.connect() is used (not ws.subscribe/ws.publish/ws.send on ws).","Confirm frontend calls the AppDeploy backend only with api from @appdeploy/client.","Confirm package.json uses bare module imports for AppDeploy packages and does not list them as dependencies.","If SPA routing is used, confirm there are no absolute client routes and HashRouter is used.","If existing code violates these rules, fix it before calling deploy_app."],"package_json_rules":[],"custom_api_usage":["For custom backend routes, define them in backend/index.ts and follow the api feature rules/examples from get_appdeploy_sdk_reference instead of inventing your own transport contract."],"backend_persistence":["For backend capabilities and exact SDK methods, use get_appdeploy_sdk_reference with the exact features the app will use and do not invent SDK methods.","When implementing invite code functionality (create/share/join links for rooms, sessions, chats, multiplayer games), use @appdeploy/sdk invites.create/resolve/join/revoke for both anonymous and authenticated flows rather than custom invite state handlers. Backend returns invite codes only; frontend builds share URLs with invitesClient.buildJoinUrl(code, { path }).","Secrets: never put secret values in chat, deploy_app params, files, or source code. Use create_secret_entry, have the user open the pre-authorized browser page and submit the value there, then poll get_secret_entry_status.","Secrets: when showing secret_entry_url in terminal or CLI clients, print the full raw URL in plain text instead of a markdown link label.","Secrets: new apps bind submitted secret_entry_ids in deploy_app; existing apps use set_app_secrets. Backend runtime reads use @appdeploy/sdk secrets.readSecret(name) / secrets.listSecretNames().","Include the secrets feature in get_appdeploy_sdk_reference for exact backend secret types, examples, and constraints."],"cron_jobs":["Use cron.json only when the app actually needs scheduled work.","Do not schedule AI-heavy work every 5 minutes. For cron handlers that call ai.* APIs, prefer hourly/daily cadence, skip unchanged data with a stored fingerprint/timestamp, and handle AI 429s by backing off with cached data.","Include the cron feature in get_app_template/get_appdeploy_sdk_reference for exact format and examples."],"auth_usage":["Frontend auth comes from @appdeploy/client; backend auth and middleware come from @appdeploy/sdk.","Include the auth feature in get_appdeploy_sdk_reference for exact scopes, middleware, and protected-route rules."],"notifications_usage":["Frontend notifications use @appdeploy/client and backend delivery uses @appdeploy/sdk; never call Firebase/FCM APIs directly.","Include the notifications feature in get_appdeploy_sdk_reference for exact subscription and delivery examples."],"ui_guidance":["Follow the user's requested product behavior closely and ship a polished, responsive UI that hides technical internals from end users.","Use get_app_template as the structural baseline and preserve template quality while customizing the experience.","Use any UI skill you have freely; do not limit your design or code to AppDeploy-provided UI, CSS, or icon templates."],"mobile_game_guidance":["Only when the user asks for a mobile-first game: keep gameplay within the viewport and design controls for touch-first input."],"status_behavior":["deploy_app is non-blocking; deployments typically complete within a few seconds.","'deploying' is a success in-progress state, not an error. Do not redeploy to unstick.","'deployed_and_testing' means build completed but e2e/QA checks are still running.","deploy_app can also return immediate validation/linter feedback before deployment starts. Treat this as a fix-and-retry signal, not a terminal failure.","After deploy_app returns, call get_app_status only when deployment.status is in-progress ('deploying', 'deployed_and_testing', or 'deleting') and deployment.app_id is present; keep polling until status is 'ready', 'failed', or 'deleted'.","Always read response.message and validation feedback on every status check.","If get_app_status returns QA/e2e/runtime errors, attempt automatic fixes and redeploy up to 3 times before asking the user for guidance.","If get_app_status includes deployment.url while status is 'deploying', treat it as not-ready and do not present it as live/shareable yet.","If status is 'deployed_and_testing', it is still in-progress: keep polling for terminal status and do not present a ready-style final summary yet.","If still deploying, deployed_and_testing, or deleting, wait at least 5 seconds before checking again.","Backend console.error() and console.warn() calls are automatically captured and surfaced in get_app_status backend error logs. Use them for debugging.","If e2e_tests.status is 'failed', inspect the deployed snapshot with src_glob/src_grep/src_read before guessing.","If e2e_tests.status is 'failed', you MUST call get_e2e_qa_run_details before proposing a fix, redeploying, or explaining root cause. Do not rely on get_app_status alone for the failing-run context.","For e2e debugging after that, use the QA run details together with the frontend/backend errors returned by get_app_status to guide reproduction and repair."],"post_deploy_workflow":{"poll":{"tool":"get_app_status","interval_seconds":5,"until_status":["ready","failed","deleted"]},"always_review":["Always read response.message and validation errors/warnings.","If get_app_status returns an error summary, treat it as authoritative.","Always inspect and handle qaSnapshot/errors even when deployment status is 'ready', because runtime issues can still be present.","If deploy_app returns validation errors, inspect validation.errors plus files_to_fix and fix_hint, then fix all reported issues in one pass before retrying deploy_app.","If status is 'deploying', keep polling and do not share a live URL yet.","If status is 'deployed_and_testing' and a deployment widget is present, do not duplicate the link or full status in chat; briefly note tests are still running and continue polling until status is 'ready', 'failed', or 'deleted'.","If status is 'deployed_and_testing' and no widget is present, you may show `Live URL: <url>`, but still treat it as in-progress and keep polling.","If status is 'ready', show `Live URL: <url>`."],"on_ready":["If validation errors/warnings exist, show them to the user and attempt automatic fixes and redeploy up to 3 times.","Return the public URL to the user."],"on_failed":["Show the failure summary to the user.","Review the errors field and files_to_fix in the response.","Read the deployed snapshot with src_glob/src_grep/src_read before proposing fixes.","If e2e_tests.status is 'failed', you MUST call get_e2e_qa_run_details before proposing a fix, redeploying, or explaining root cause. Do not rely on get_app_status alone for the failing-run context.","After that, use the QA run details together with the frontend/backend errors returned by get_app_status to guide reproduction and repair.","Prioritize fixing files listed in files_to_fix; for unlisted errors, fix the relevant file.","Prefer diffs[] for surgical fixes (works for both new template-based apps and updates). Use content for new files not in template.","Fix issues automatically and redeploy.","If get_app_status returns QA/e2e/runtime errors, attempt automatic fixes and redeploy up to 3 times before asking the user for guidance."],"on_deleted":["Confirm deletion to the user."]},"routing":{"spa":{"forbid_absolute_routes":true,"allowed_strategies":["relative routes","HashRouter"]}},"imports":{"forbid_frontend":["@appdeploy/sdk"],"forbid_backend":["@appdeploy/client"]},"backend_entrypoint_path":"backend/index.ts","frontend_backend_calling_rule":"","local_workflow":["Always write app files to a local working directory on disk. This is your working copy and the source of truth for all deploy operations.","The remote snapshot is the canonical deployed state (like a git remote). For UPDATES, sync before editing: use src_glob/src_read to pull the latest snapshot into your local working directory, then edit locally.","For NEW APPS, create the local working directory from get_app_template output, then develop locally.","Use upload_assets to send files to the server — this is the default for all deploys. Only call deploy_app without upload_id for trivially small inline changes (e.g. a one-line fix, a small diff).","If local filesystem access is truly unavailable, fall back to in-memory edits and send only the minimal changed files.","Keep local-only metadata (app_id, notes) outside the deploy tree."]}
